name: markdown-all-in-one
description: All you need to write Markdown (keyboard shortcuts, table of contents, auto preview and more)

works: Enter continues and ends lists, task lists and quotes; Tab and Shift+Tab change the list level
Bold, italic, strikethrough and heading level shortcuts, on a selection and on a word
Table of contents with section numbers, updated on save, and its status code lens
Format Document aligns tables; completions for links to files and headings (markdown.extension.completion.enabled)
Print to HTML next to the file; pasting a link over a selection turns it into a Markdown link
limits: No preview contributions: Diode has no Markdown preview, so preview styles and math in the preview do nothing
Syntax decorations are only partly visible: strikethrough shows, a code span has no background of its own
Snippet paths go in without a snippet session: the caret lands on the first stop and Tab does not walk the rest
Ctrl+I needs a terminal with extended keys: elsewhere it is the same byte as Tab; run Toggle Italic from the Command Palette

readme:
# Markdown All in One

Keyboard shortcuts, list editing, table of contents, table formatting, completions and export to HTML for Markdown files.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.
